title: GOD OF JABEZ Change My STORY
text: [Music] The God of heaven has brought you into this atmosphere for a divine encounter. Tonight is not an ordinary gathering. It is a prophetic appointment with destiny. Hear the word of the Lord in 1st Chronicles 4:9-10. And Jabz was more honorable than his brethren. And his mother called his name Jabz, saying, Because I bear him with sorrow. And Jabas called on the God of Israel, saying, "Oh, that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me." And God granted him that which he requested. Child of God, listen carefully. Jabas's life began with pain, sorrow, limitation, and reproach. His name itself carried a prophecy of pain. But one encounter with the God of Israel shifted the trajectory of his destiny. The scripture says, "And God granted him that which he requested." Hear me. In the same way, your story is about to change tonight. That which has followed you from birth, that which has followed you from your family line, that which has mocked your prayers and resisted your lifting, it is coming to an end in the name of Jesus. I prophesy over you. Every negative identity placed upon you is torn away. Every name you were given by pain, by failure, by defeat, by delay, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. You will no longer be identified by sorrow. You will no longer be defined by failure. The God of Jabus will give you a new name, a new identity, a new destiny. Isaiah 62:2 declares, "And thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name." May that new name rest upon you tonight. I decree and declare, let there be enlargement. The same God who enlarged the coast of Jabis, enlarge your borders, expand your influence, multiply your opportunities, increase your resources. I command enlargement in your finances, enlargement in your family. Now I decree by the authority of scripture, every curse over your life is broken. Every altar speaking against your destiny collapse by fire. Every arrow fired against your progress return to sender. Every chain tying you down. Break now. Every embargo placed on your destiny scatter. Every monitoring spirit be blinded. Every gate of brass and bar of iron be cut as sunder. Psalm 311 says, "Thou has turned for me my morning into dancing. Thou has put off my sackcloth and gathered me with gladness. I prophesy this word over you tonight. Your mourning is turned to dancing. Your tears are turned to testimonies. Your rejection is turned to acceptance. Your failure is turned to success. Your delay is turned to speed. Your captivity is turned to liberty. Father, we extol you tonight. We worship you because you are the changer of stories. You are the one who lifts men from the donghill and sets them among princes. You are the God who breaks yolks, shatters chains, and rewrites destinies. Receive all glory. Receive all honor. Receive all praise. And now I seal every declaration with the blood of Jesus. Your story has changed. Your testimony has begun. Your destiny is lifted. Your coast is enlarged. Your sorrow has ended. Walk into this new season with joy, with boldness, with confidence, knowing that the God of Jabz has turned your story around in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen and amen. The same God who had Jabz is alive and present in this atmosphere. The Bible says in Hebrews 13:8, Jesus Christ the same yesterday and today and forever. That means the God who answered Jabus and turned his sorrow into honor has not changed. What he did then he will do again for you. He will turn your story around. I speak prophetically over your life. Every label of sorrow shone under the sound of my voice. Your story has been one of near success syndrome. Getting close to breakthrough and suddenly it slips away. But tonight I stand in the name of Jesus and I break that cycle. That cycle of almost there but never there. I scatter it now. That spirit of delay. Go. That spirit of disappointment. Leave. That altar of rejection catch fire. Your story is turning around now and I prophesy enlargement upon your life. Jabz cried, "Oh, that you would enlarge my coast. I decree enlargement over your family. Receive children. Receive fruitfulness. Receive joy, enlargement over your finances. Step into new contracts, new clients, new streams of income, enlargement over your career, promotion, visibility, relevance, enlargement over your ministry, more influence, more anointing, more impact. Psalm 115 verse14 says, "The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children. I decree this scripture fulfilled in your life. Beloved, lift your right hand and declare with me. I decree and declare my story is turning around. >> I will not die in sorrow. >> I will not end in failure. >> I am enlarged on every side. My family is blessed. My hands are blessed. My head is lifted. My coast is enlarged. My life will glorify God. Thus saith the spirit of God. There is someone listening to me. You have been praying secretly. Lord, why is my life like this? Why is my case different? The Lord says, I have heard your cry tonight and before this week is over, I will surprise you. Expect sudden divine intervention. Expect a phone call of good news. Expect supernatural favor. Expect restoration of what was lost. Father, we exalt you for what you are doing. You are the God who takes men from sorrow to joy, from shame to honor, from smallness to enlargement. I decree and declare every arrow fired against you to grieve you, to bring you into sorrow, to break your faith is returned back to send in the name of Jesus. Psalm 7:15-16 says, "He made a pit and digged it and is fallen into the ditch which he made. His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate. Every trap set for you this week, the enemy will fall into it. Every pit dug for you, your adversaries will be buried in it. Every incantation raised against you, let it backfire. Every voice of accusation be silenced forever. Someone under the sound of my voice. There is a repeated circle of loss. You rise and suddenly something pulls you down. Tonight, by the power of the God of Jabz, that circle is broken. That spirit of rise and fall, scatter by fire. that altar of sudden disappointment collapse now. I decree stability into your destiny. I decree establishment into your career. I decree fruitfulness into your family. You will no longer sow and another reap. You will no longer build and another inhabit. You will no longer labor and be emptyhanded. Now hear me. The God of Jabz turned his reproach into honor. I prophesy over you. Honor in your business. Honor in your workplace. Honor in your ministry. May your name be spoken with respect. May your name be associated with favor. May your name be remembered for good. As Modia was remembered in the palace, so shall you be remembered this week. Let every spirit of dishonor and mockery be reversed. Psalm 311 declares, "Thou has turned for me my morning into dancing. Thou has put off my sackcloth and gathered me with gladness. Your morning is turned into dancing tonight." Lift your hands and make these decrees with faith. I decree and declare that my story is turning around. I will not be a victim of sorrow. Father, we glorify you. You are the God who turns stories around. You are the one who causes the barren to sing, who causes the poor to rejoice, who causes the rejected to be enthroned. We magnify you because you are doing it again tonight. Now I seal these prayers with the covenant of the blood of Jesus. By the power of the cross, your story has shifted. By the authority of the word, your testimony is established. By the spirit of God, your destiny is lifted. Go forth this week in victory. Go forth in joy. Go forth in enlargement. And may the whole world know that the God of Jabus has turned your story around in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen. And amen. Tonight we stand in the place of warfare. For the God of Jabz has arisen to fight for his people. The scripture says in Psalm 68:1, "Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him." And the word tells us in 1st Chronicles 4:10 that when Jabus cried that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me. God answered, "Tonight, as you cry unto the Lord, his hand will rest upon you, and evil will be far from your dwelling place. I decree in the name of Jesus, every evil covenant tying your family to cycles of pain and hardship, break now. Every foundation of idolatry speaking against your lifting, be uprooted. Every shrine where your name has been mentioned, I command the fire of the Holy Ghost to consume it. Every altar demanding your blood, I silence it by the blood of Jesus. Isaiah 49:25 declares, "For I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children." This week, the Lord contends with those who contend with you. He rises as the man of war to scatter the plans of your enemies. Beloved, hear me. The Bible says in Colossians, lift your hands and decree with me. I decree by the blood of Jesus, every altar fighting my destiny is broken. Every course is reversed. Every arrow is returned. I am lifted above reproach. My story is turning around. I will not be a victim of evil. The hand of the Lord rest upon me. I walk in favor. I walk in victory. I walk in enlargement. Thus, saith the spirit of God. Someone listening to me, your destiny has been locked in an evil padlock, but I see the Lord breaking it open. Another person, your finances have been buried in the ground by wicked men, but the Lord says, "This week, I am restoring you." someone else. You have been forgotten in the place of help. But the Lord says, "I am causing your name to be remembered. Father, we worship you. We exalt you as the God who breaks chains. The God who turns shame into glory. The God who lifts men from the pit to the palace. Tonight we enthrone you as the God of Jabz. The God who changes stories. And now I decree over every life under the sound of my voice. May the testimony of Jabz be your testimony. May the God who enlarged him enlarge you. May the God who preserved him preserve you. May the God who blessed him bless you indeed. May your story be rewritten tonight in the mighty name of Jesus. It is done. Amen and amen. Hear me as I declare with the voice of prophecy. This night is not an ordinary night. It is a night of divine turnaround. The same God who answered Jabus when he cried is the same God who answers us tonight. For the word says in Jeremiah 33:3, "Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and show thee great and mighty things which thou knowest not." And in 1 Chronicles 4:10, the Bible says, "And God granted him that which he requested." May the Lord grant you every request lifted before him. Tonight, I prophesy over your destiny. This is your season of enlargement. Like Jabus, your coast is enlarged. I decree increase in your finances, multiplication in your business, expansion in your influence. Isaiah 54:2 says, "Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the cutings of thine inhabitations. Spear not, lengthen thy courts, and strengthen thy stakes. Receive supernatural expansion. May the Lord push you beyond limitations. May the hand of God take you into territories you could never enter by yourself. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice has been living under delay. Every time you are close to breakthrough, something pulls you back. But tonight I decree by the power of the Holy Ghost, no more delay. Habacook 2:3 declares, "Though it tar, wait for it because it will surely come, it will not tarry. I speak acceleration into your life. What has taken others 10 years, you will accomplish in one year. What men thought was impossible, God will make possible for you this week. I return every evil arrow sent against you back to sender. Arrows of sickness, go back. Arrows of untimely death, go back. Arrows of shame, go back. Arrows of failure, go back. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. Every weapon against you is destroyed. Every tongue against you is condemned. Lift your voice and decree with me. I decree and declare. My story is turning around. No curse will prevail against me. No altar will resist me. No arrow will prosper against me. I walk in enlargement. I walk in favor. I walk in victory. The God of Jabus is my God. My story is changing now. I see in the spirit. Someone has been mocked because of baronness. They have laughed in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. And amen. Beloved, hear me clearly. For the spirit of God is strong upon this atmosphere. The God of Jabus who rewrote his story is about to rewrite yours permanently. The Bible says in Micah 2:13, "The breaker is come up before them. They have broken up and have passed through the gate and are gone out by it. And their king shall pass before them and the Lord on the head of them. Tonight I introduce you to the breaker, the one who shatters chains, the one who uproots altars, the one who makes a way where there is no way. Every witchcraft altar speaking against your destiny, catch fire now. Every satanic priest calling your name at midnight, let their tongues cleave to the roof of their mouths. Every evil sacrifice raised to keep you in bondage, let it be overturned by the sacrifice of Jesus on the cross. Hebrews 12:24 says, "And to Jesus, the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better things than that of Abel, let the blood of Jesus silence every evil voice speaking against you. I decree angelic intervention tonight as it was in Acts 12 when Peter was locked in prison and the angel of the Lord entered and broke his chains. I decree angelic deliverance over you. Every prison of sickness, break. Every prison of death, break. Every prison of delay, break. Every prison of rising and falling, break. Psalm 34:7 declares, "The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and deliverth them." May the angels of the Lord encamp around your family, your business, your career, and your destiny. Thus sayeth the spirit of God. Someone here has been under a siege. Every time you are about to rise, strange dreams of death, of loss, of failure appear, but tonight that siege is broken. another person your destiny as. Father, we magnify you for you are the God who fights for your people. You are the mighty deliverer. The one who turns captivity into freedom, the one who breaks the bow and cuts the spear in sunder. Tonight we give you glory because you are not only changing stories, you are enforcing generational deliverance. And now I seal these prayers with the covenant of the blood. No power will reverse them. No altar will contest them. No devil will resist them. Go into this week victorious. Go into this week untouchable. Go into this week enlarged, established, and blessed in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. It is done. Amen. And amen. The spirit of the Lord is still moving. And I sense that tonight is a night of permanent shift. The God of Jabus is in this place. The same God who turned his sorrow into honor is turning your pain into glory. The Bible says in Joel 2:25-26, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmer worm, my great army which I sent among you. And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied and praise the name of the Lord your God that had dealt wondrously with you. and my people shall never be ashamed. Tonight I prophesy restoration. Whatever has been stolen, wasted, buried, or delayed be restored in the name of Jesus. I decree restoration of your health. Every sickness that has eaten your body, every affliction that has drained your strength, every infirmity that has tied you down, I command restoration from the crown of your head to the sole of your feet. Let the healing virtue of Christ flow. Jeremiah 3:17 says, "For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, sayaeth the Lord." Tonight, let every wound, physical, emotional, spiritual, be healed. I decree restoration of your family. Every marriage under attack, every child under bondage, every relationship under tension, I speak peace. Isaiah 49:25 declares, "For I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children. I decree the Lord saves your children from the grip of evil. Every marital delay is broken. Every spirit of divorce is silenced. Every satanic agenda against your family is cancelled. Lift up your voice and decree with me. I decree and declare my years are restored. My health is restored. My finances are restored. My family is restored. My honor is restored. My destiny is restored. What the enemy stole is returned. What was buried is resurrected. What was wasted is recovered. My story is turning around forever. Thus, saith the spirit of God. Someone here, the enemy buried your glory long ago, buried it through witchcraft, buried it through ancestral covenants. But tonight I see the earth giving up what belongs to you. Another person, you lost years to mistakes and wrong decisions. But the Lord says, I will compress time for you. I will give you speed. You will overtake what you lost. And another person, your family has been marked with untimely death, but the Lord says that cycle is broken tonight. Father, we magnify you for your faithfulness. You are the restorer of wasted years, the lifter of heads, the changer of stories. We enthrone you in this atmosphere. We honor you for the testimonies already been birthed. And now I decree your restoration is permanent. Your enlargement is irreversible. Your testimony is undeniable. The God of Jabus has heard your cry and turned your story around. go forth into your new season with confidence, with joy, and with victory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
